scriptdef.name: Aktualizacja wydruków POS w bazie XL

ROOT.scriptdef: declare @slwid int = (select slw_id from cdn.Slowniki where slw_kategoria='Typy załączników' and SLW_WartoscS = 'Wydruki POS') update cdn.DaneBinarne set dab_kod = 'POS20_PL_SalesInvoiceDetails' where dab_kod = 'POS20_PL_SalesInvoice' and dab_typid=@slwid update cdn.DaneBinarne set dab_kod = 'POS20_PL_OperatorShiftDailyReport' where dab_kod = 'POS_PL_OperatorShiftDailyReport' and dab_typid=@slwid update cdn.DaneBinarne set dab_kod = 'POS20_PL_SalesAdvanceInvoiceDetails' where dab_kod = 'POS20_PL_AdvanceInvoiceDetails' and dab_typid=@slwid delete from cdn.picostanowiskawydruki where pwr_nazwa in (select dab_Nazwa from cdn.DaneBinarne where dab_kod in ('POS20_PL_SalesInvoiceQuantityCorrectionDetails_Duplicate','POS20_PL_SalesInvoice_Duplicate','POS20_PL_SalesAdvanceInvoiceCorrectionDetails','POS20_PL_AdvanceInvoiceCorrectionDetails','POS20_PL_ComplaintReturnProtocolDetails','POS20_PL_AdvanceInvoiceDetails','POS20_PL_DebitMemoDetails','POS20_PL_SalesInvoice_Duplicate','POS20_PL_SalesInvoiceQuantityCorrectionDetails_Duplicate') and dab_typid=@slwid) delete cdn.DaneBinarne where dab_kod in ('POS20_PL_SalesInvoiceQuantityCorrectionDetails_Duplicate','POS20_PL_SalesInvoice_Duplicate','POS20_PL_SalesAdvanceInvoiceCorrectionDetails','POS20_PL_AdvanceInvoiceCorrectionDetails','POS20_PL_ComplaintReturnProtocolDetails','POS20_PL_AdvanceInvoiceDetails','POS20_PL_DebitMemoDetails','POS20_PL_SalesInvoice_Duplicate','POS20_PL_SalesInvoiceQuantityCorrectionDetails_Duplicate') and dab_typid=@slwid IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'PicoStanowiskaOperatorzy_CzasModyfikacji' AND type = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.PicoStanowiskaOperatorzy_CzasModyfikacji update cdn.PicoStanowiskaOperatorzy set PKn_CzasModyfikacji = 0 ALTER TABLE [CDN].[Atrybuty] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_Atr_GUID] ALTER TABLE [CDN].[Atrybuty] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_Atr_GUID] DEFAULT (CONVERT([varchar](36),newid())) FOR [Atr_GUID] update cdn.DaneBinarne set DAB_Nazwa = 'Wydruk formularza karty kontrahenta' where dab_kod='POS20_PL_CustomerDetails' update cdn.Atrybuty set atr_guid = newid() where atr_guid='' or atr_guid is null set nocount off;
